ExamProgress.title: ExamProgress
ExamProgress.description: In-progress or latest saved state for the 50-question Grade X English UAS exam, synced offline and online.

studentName.description: Student name entered on the exam cover.

answers.description: Fixed 50-element list of selected options ('', 'a', 'b', 'c', or 'd').

flaggedQuestions.description: List of 1-based question numbers marked ragu-ragu / flagged.

currentQuestion.description: 1-based index of the currently active question (1..50).

status.description: Current status of the active exam session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: Immutable completed submission record for the 50-question Grade X English UAS exam.

studentNumber.description: Student attendance/absen number at submission time.

correctCount.description: Total number of correct answers out of 50.

durationSeconds.description: Time spent completing the exam in seconds.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp when exam was submitted (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when attempt record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/exam_progress/{progressI.description: User-scoped live exam draft progress for cross-device cloud sync and offline persistence.

/users/{userId}/exam_attempts/{attemptId.description: User-scoped history of completed exam submissions and scores.
